question: Explain the benefits of planning an audit of financial statements under SA 300.
sources: SA 300 Planning an Audit of Financial Statements

points.label: Attention to important areas
points.description: Planning helps the auditor give proper attention to the important areas of the audit.
points.basis: SA 300, role and benefits of planning

points.label: Identify problems early
points.description: Planning helps identify and resolve possible problems in good time.
points.basis: SA 300, role and benefits of planning

points.label: Organise and manage the engagement
points.description: Planning helps organise and manage the audit so it is done effectively and efficiently.
points.basis: SA 300, role and benefits of planning

points.label: Selecting and assigning the team
points.description: Planning helps select team members with the right skills and assign work to them properly.
points.basis: SA 300, role and benefits of planning

points.label: Direction, supervision and review
points.description: Planning helps in directing and supervising the team and reviewing their work.
points.basis: SA 300, role and benefits of planning

points.label: Coordination with others
points.description: Planning helps coordinate work done by auditors of components and by experts.
points.basis: SA 300, role and benefits of planning
